title: A Prince's Proposal to the Saintess Who Failed him
description: Read A Prince’s Proposal to the Saintess Who Failed him , Though I Am the Hated Saint, the Young Prince of the Nation I Failed to Save Has Proposed to Me , 恨まれ聖女なのに救えなかった国の年下公王様に求婚されました , Uramare Seijo na no ni Sukue na Katta Kuni no Toshishita Kou Ou-sama ni Kyuukon Saremashita A Saint fails to purify a deadly calamity, causing devastation to a powerful nation. Disgraced and abandoned, she receives a sudden marriage proposal from the very ruler whose country she failed to save. Accepting as a form of atonement, she loses her powers due to her father’s scheme. On her way to fulfill the engagement, her carriage is attacked and a lone knight appears before her.
